remarks:
Three Floors of Character at the End of a Seneca Heights Cul-de-Sac

The street ends at your front door. That's the first thing you notice: no through traffic, no hurry, just a private little pocket of Seneca Heights where the pavement runs out and the yard begins.

And what a yard. It's genuinely larger than what this neighborhood usually offers, the kind of space that makes you start sketching out garden beds and fire-pit corners before you've even walked inside.

Step in and the floors tell you someone has cared for this house. The hardwood has been recently refinished, and it glows. There's a formal dining room, a real one, the kind that makes a holiday dinner feel like an occasion, and it opens directly onto the back deck, so the party spills outside without anyone crossing the kitchen. When the weather turns, the natural gas fireplace takes over, and the whole house settles into that warm, close, mid-winter comfort that no supplemental heater has ever managed.

The kitchen is a legitimate retro gem. Bold, original, full of personality, a space with a point of view. Keep it as the conversation piece it already is, or make it your own later.

Upstairs, you'll find two bedrooms and a fully and tastefully remodeled bathroom. One of those bedrooms began life as two, and a previous owner opened it up into a single generous space, a nice bonus for anyone wanting room to stretch out, and an easy path back to a fourth bedroom for anyone who'd rather have the door count. It also has a surprisingly great view out of the windows that might remind you of a Hallmark movie.

Then the third floor, which is the real surprise: a private top-level retreat with a large walk-in closet, ready to serve as a primary suite tucked well away from the rest of the house.

Add the attached one-car garage, Magnano Park just around the corner, and downtown close enough to walk, and you have the combination that almost never shows up together: character, location, and the practical stuff that actually makes a house livable
